name: Sidereal-Spire
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws an orbital debris ring, patient as erosion itself.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
